rows.label: Los Angeles Lakers
rows.hook: has retired jerseys for Kobe Bryant and Magic Johnson and won a huge pile of championships

rows.label: Los Angeles Clippers
rows.hook: shares a building with its city rival and had a high-flying "Lob City" era

rows.label: New York Knicks
rows.description: National Basketball Association team in New York City
rows.hook: is a storied franchise whose fans pack a famous arena in America's largest city

rows.label: Golden State Warriors
rows.description: National Basketball Association team in San Francisco, California
rows.hook: won titles behind Stephen Curry's record-setting three-point shooting

rows.label: Chicago Bulls
rows.hook: won six championships with Michael Jordan and Scottie Pippen

rows.label: Boston Celtics
rows.hook: wears green and has won more championships than any other team, with Larry Bird among its legends

rows.label: Toronto Raptors
rows.description: National Basketball Association team in Toronto, Ontario
rows.hook: is the only Canadian team in the league and won its first title behind Kawhi Leonard

rows.label: Miami Heat
rows.description: American professional basketball team based in Miami
rows.hook: won titles with a Big Three of LeBron James, Dwyane Wade and Chris Bosh

rows.label: Charlotte Hornets
rows.description: American professional basketball team based in Charlotte, North Carolina
rows.hook: was once owned by Michael Jordan and is known for teal and purple colors

rows.label: Sacramento Kings
rows.hook: celebrates home wins by lighting a purple beam above its arena

rows.label: San Antonio Spurs
rows.description: National Basketball Association team in San Antonio
rows.hook: won five championships with Tim Duncan and coach Gregg Popovich

rows.label: Brooklyn Nets
rows.hook: moved in from New Jersey and wears stark black and white

rows.label: Minnesota Timberwolves
rows.hook: is led by high-flying guard Anthony Edwards

rows.label: Atlanta Hawks
rows.hook: is led by sharpshooting guard Trae Young

rows.label: Portland Trail Blazers
rows.hook: featured Damian Lillard and his long-range buzzer beaters

rows.label: Washington Wizards
rows.description: National Basketball Association team in Washington, D.C.
rows.hook: used to be called the Bullets before switching to a name about sorcerers

rows.label: Cleveland Cavaliers
rows.description: National Basketball Association team in Cleveland, Ohio
rows.hook: won its only title when LeBron James rallied it from a 3-1 series deficit

rows.label: Denver Nuggets
rows.hook: won its first championship behind big man Nikola Jokic

rows.label: Detroit Pistons
rows.hook: were the "Bad Boys" known for rough defense who won back-to-back titles

rows.label: Houston Rockets
rows.description: National Basketball Association team in Houston, Texas
rows.hook: won back-to-back titles with Hakeem Olajuwon

rows.label: Milwaukee Bucks
rows.hook: is led by Giannis Antetokounmpo, known as the Greek Freak

rows.label: Oklahoma City Thunder
rows.description: American professional basketball team based in Oklahoma City, United States
rows.hook: started life in Seattle as the SuperSonics

rows.label: Utah Jazz
rows.hook: featured the Hall of Fame duo of Karl Malone and John Stockton

rows.label: New Orleans Pelicans
rows.hook: is led by Zion Williamson, a powerful high-flying forward

rows.label: Memphis Grizzlies
rows.description: National Basketball Association team in Memphis, Tennessee
rows.hook: began life in Vancouver before relocating

rows.label: Phoenix Suns
rows.hook: ran a fast-break offense with Steve Nash known as seven seconds or less

rows.label: Orlando Magic
rows.hook: is based near Disney World and once paired Shaquille O'Neal with Penny Hardaway

rows.label: Indiana Pacers
rows.description: professional basketball team from Indianapolis, Indiana
rows.hook: featured sharpshooter Reggie Miller, who tormented the Knicks in the playoffs
